ogDesc: The best hotels in Bangkapi by budget.
intro: Bangkapi is a large residential district on Bangkok's east side, and its landmark is The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi at the junction where Lat Phrao Road meets Sereethai and Nawamin. Around it you'll find fresh markets, a night market, a Lotus's hypermarket, and local restaurants that stay open late. What changed the area is the MRT Yellow Line along Lat Phrao Road, with the Lat Phrao 101 station right by this zone, letting you ride to connect with the other lines. The Orange Line under construction will tie it even closer to the centre in future. Stays here lean toward budget hotels and serviced apartments, many built for longer visits, people with business at NIDA or Ramkhamhaeng University, and anyone wanting a good-value room near the mall. The trade-off is the fair distance from the main tourist sights, some hotels sit deep in a soi, and Lat Phrao and Sereethai roads jam up at rush hour.

blocks.html: Short answer: Bangkapi is a real residential district on Bangkok's east side, centred on The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi, running along the MRT Yellow Line around Lat Phrao 101 and close to Ramkhamhaeng University and NIDA. Most stays here are budget hotels and serviced apartments, with markets and street food all around. Rooms start around ฿650 and rise to about ฿1,500 for a newer hotel.

items.name: View Place Hotel & Residence Lat Phrao 130
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Long stays on a budget · walk to The Mall · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A serviced apartment on Soi Lat Phrao 130 in Khlong Chan, within walking distance of the MRT Lat Phrao 101 station and The Mall Bangkapi. There's parking, an EV charger, restaurants, and a 7-Eleven close by. It's very cheap and built for multi-night stays. Reviews praise the clean rooms, fresh linens, and kind staff, though to be straight the beds are firm, some rooms charge extra for a softer one, and the Wi-Fi is fairly limited.

items.name: imm hotel Ladprao Bangkapi Bangkok
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: By the MRT Yellow Line · near the market and Lotus's · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 212-room hotel on Soi Lat Phrao 127 in Khlong Chan, right by the MRT Yellow Line and a few minutes' walk to Lotus's and The Mall Bangkapi. Rooms have air-con and a flat-screen TV at a low price. Reviews praise the helpful staff, spacious rooms, fast Wi-Fi, and cheap food nearby. Worth knowing: the building and rooms are showing their age, the air-con sits oddly in some rooms, and it faces a wet market, so there's an occasional smell.

items.name: We Hotel
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Newer modern rooms · quiet · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small, newer hotel on Soi Lat Phrao 140 in Khlong Chan, about a 5-minute drive to The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi. Rooms are done in calm, modern tones with a smart TV, free Wi-Fi, and free parking. It scores around 8.6 in reviews for cleanliness, quiet and private rooms, and soft beds, making it a good pick for a newer, clean room on a budget. Worth knowing: it has few rooms, so book ahead, and the front desk isn't open 24 hours.

items.name: Mall Suites Hotel
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: Closest to The Mall · rooms with a pantry · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A hotel on Soi Lat Phrao 144, right next to The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi — almost a walk across. The draw is spacious rooms with a pantry corner, suiting families or longer stays, plus free Wi-Fi and free parking. Reviews like the location for walking to the mall and finding food easily, the clean rooms, and the value. Worth knowing: it has been renovating in parts, so check the room condition before booking, and there's nearby construction that can bring some noise.

items.name: 130 Hotel & Residence Bangkok
items.meta: ★ 3-star · Best for: By MRT Lat Phrao 101 · comfy beds · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A hotel-and-residence on Soi Lat Phrao 130 in Khlong Chan, next to a 7-Eleven and the MRT Yellow Line's Lat Phrao 101 station, within walking distance of The Mall Bangkapi. There's a restaurant, a gym, free Wi-Fi, and free parking. It scores in the low 8s, with guests singling out the comfy beds and the value, and plenty of restaurants around. Some reviews note the soi entrance looks quiet but feels safe, and breakfast is basic.

items.name: The Bedroom Ladprao 101
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Newer, clean hotel · quiet and comfortable · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A newer, cleaner hotel than most options in the area, on the Lat Phrao 101 side of Bangkapi. Rooms have a flat-screen TV and a separate walk-in shower, and there's a gym, a restaurant, and free Wi-Fi and parking. It scores around 7.9, with reviews praising very clean rooms, good linens, and how new the place feels — a fit if you want a step up in this district. The honest trade-off is the distance from the centre; some guests say hailing a taxi and walking to the metro aren't that easy.

faq.q: How do you get into the city from Bangkapi?
faq.a: Mainly the MRT Yellow Line along Lat Phrao Road, with the Lat Phrao 101 station right by this area; you can change to the Blue Line at Lat Phrao or connect onward. The Orange Line under construction will make the trip into the centre easier in future. Worth knowing: some hotels sit deep in a soi, so you'll take a motorbike taxi or taxi to the station, and Lat Phrao and Sereethai roads get fairly congested at rush hour.

faq.q: Who is Bangkapi a good fit for?
faq.a: It suits people with specific errands who want a lower rate — visiting NIDA or Ramkhamhaeng University, shopping and eating at The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi, or wanting a value room for a longer stay. The surroundings are genuinely residential, with fresh markets, a night market, and lots of cheap food. But if your plan is the Grand Palace, Chinatown, or strolling Sukhumvit, Bangkapi is far out and you'll need to budget travel time.

faq.q: How is staying in Bangkapi different from the Ramkhamhaeng–Hua Mak side?
faq.a: The two areas sit next to each other but have different centres. Ramkhamhaeng–Hua Mak clusters around Ramkhamhaeng University, ABAC, and Rajamangala Stadium, while Bangkapi clusters around The Mall Lifestore Bangkapi and the Lat Phrao 101–144 sois. Many Bangkapi stays are cheap serviced apartments within walking distance of the MRT Yellow Line at Lat Phrao 101. If your business is the mall or NIDA, pick Bangkapi; if you're heading to a concert or football match at the stadium, the Hua Mak side is closer.
